rows.expectation: labelled line still links TR-3
rows.text:
Decision record.
Decision: The board approved change CR-7 on 6 March because test report TR-3 of 4 March shows the rollback passing.

rows.expectation: evidence before the decision, linked by the stated reliance
rows.text: Decision record. Test report TR-3 of 4 March shows the rollback passing. The board approved change CR-7 on 6 March. The approval relies on test report TR-3.

rows.expectation: evidence after the decision, linked through the shared identifier
rows.text: Decision record. The board approved change CR-7 on 6 March. The approval relies on test report TR-3. Test report TR-3 of 4 March shows the rollback passing.

rows.expectation: headings on their own lines; TR-3 linked
rows.text:
Background
The rollback was rehearsed.
Basis
Test report TR-3 of 4 March shows the rollback passing.
Outcome
The board approved change CR-7 on 6 March, citing test report TR-3.

rows.expectation: a title with a version and a date is metadata: no evidence
rows.text: Change approval summary, version 2, 4 March. The board approved change CR-7 on 6 March.

rows.expectation: anaphoric source ("that survey") is a stated link
rows.text: Decision record. The survey of 9 May (report SV-2) measured 2 litres per hour of ingress. The order was raised to priority 1 on the strength of that survey.

rows.expectation: facts not linked in words: no stated link
rows.text: Decision record. The survey of 9 May (report SV-2) measured 2 litres per hour of ingress. The order was raised to priority 1.

rows.expectation: missed: "as noted above" is not read as a link
rows.text: Decision record. The survey of 9 May (report SV-2) measured 2 litres per hour of ingress. As noted above, the order was raised to priority 1.

rows.expectation: facts naming the decided item are an inferred link: they stop the no-evidence flag
rows.text: Decision record. Work order WO-55 was raised to priority 1 on 9 May. Work order WO-55 was surveyed on 8 May and the survey measured 2 litres per hour.

rows.expectation: an unrelated identifier does not stop the no-evidence flag
rows.text: Decision record. Work order WO-55 was raised to priority 1 on 9 May. Locker LK-4 was cleaned on 3 February.

rows.expectation: same event, two dates: conflict
rows.text: Decision record. The committee meeting was held on 7 August. The minutes record that the committee meeting was held on 9 August.

rows.expectation: different events: no conflict
rows.text: Decision record. The request was received on 3 May. The request was approved on 9 May.

rows.expectation: different requests: no conflict
rows.text: Decision record. Request RQ-1 was received on 3 May. Request RQ-2 was received on 9 May.

rows.expectation: title date and the next meeting: no conflict
rows.text: Meeting summary, steering committee, 7 August. The next committee meeting is on 4 September.

rows.expectation: original and revised instances: no conflict
rows.text: Decision record. The original deadline was 3 May. The revised deadline was 10 May.

rows.expectation: previous and current review: no conflict
rows.text: Decision record. The previous review took place on 2 March. The review took place on 6 April and found no defects. The board approved the change on 8 April because the review found no defects.

rows.expectation: a title date is not on the decision path
rows.text: Committee summary, 7 August. The pilot was extended to 30 November under paragraph 4.

rows.expectation: decision date and linked evidence date are both on the path
rows.text: Decision record. The manager approved the repair on 5 April because inspection report IR-9 of 2 April found a cracked weld.

rows.expectation: an extraction date is not on the decision path
rows.text: Decision record. This summary was extracted from the case system on 30 October. The manager approved the repair on 5 April because inspection report IR-9 of 2 April found a cracked weld.

rows.expectation: a publication date inside an authority citation is not linked evidence
rows.text: Decision record. Policy P-3, published 1 May, sets out repair limits. The manager approved the repair on 5 April under Policy P-3 because inspection report IR-9 of 2 April found a cracked weld.

rows.expectation: a planned and an actual mention of one report are not compared
rows.text: Decision record. The vendor report is due on 29 August. The vendor report was received on 3 September.

rows.expectation: opposite outcomes for the same unnumbered object: conflict
rows.text: Decision record. The release manager authorized deployment on 19 September. The release manager refused deployment on 19 September.

rows.expectation: opposite outcomes for different items: no conflict
rows.text: Decision record. Release 5.2 was approved on 19 September because run RS-1 passed. Release 5.3 was refused on 19 September because scan SC-4 failed.
